UPDATE lx_tweets t JOIN lx_profiles p ON p.id=? SET t.likes=JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(t.likes,'$',p.username) WHERE t.id=? AND NOT JSON_CONTAINS(t.likes,JSON_QUOTE(p.username))
